description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core API controller named AuthController, responsible for handling user authentication endpoints such as registration and login. It interacts with an authentication service (IAuthService) and returns JWT tokens along with user info.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: API controller managing registration and login endpoints for user authentication.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Handles user registration requests, invoking IAuthService.RegisterAsync and returning a JWT token or error.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user login requests, invoking IAuthService.LoginAsync and returning a JWT token or error.
